verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page names customizable fields and workflows, plus global and project-level configuration. Hands-on users confirm custom workflows that fit their team's process. Community complaints about admin overhead and over-configuration temper ease of use but do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of field and status configuration (the evidence is only marketing one-liners), and explicit first-party mention of customizing workflow statuses specifically.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Scale processes and save time with customizable workflows that integrate with your tech stack.
